output.title: Multi-region active/active
output.description: Route 53 sends each customer to the nearest healthy region; both regions take writes and a DynamoDB global table replicates them.

simulations.title: Region outage and failover
simulations.description: us-east-1's API fails; requests in flight error until health checks trip, then Route 53 sends everyone to eu-west-1.

action.text: Both regions are live. Route 53 sends each customer to the closer one, and every write replicates to the other region in about a second. Each dot is two checkouts.
us-east-1 has an outage. Until Route 53's health checks fail, requests sent there error out.
Health checks trip and Route 53 stops answering with us-east-1. eu-west-1 is sized to carry everyone.
No data was stranded: everything us-east-1 wrote before the outage had already replicated to eu-west-1.

expectations.label: A short error blip before failover

simulations.title: Both regions take writes
simulations.description: A sale peaks at 600 checkouts a second; each region serves half and the replicas converge.

action.text: Active/active: both regions serve customers and accept writes. Neither waits for the other. Each dot is 10 checkouts.
The sale peaks at 600 a second. Each region carries half, with room to take all of it if the other fails.
Writes replicate asynchronously in both directions; conflicting updates resolve last-writer-wins. When the sale ends, the two replicas hold the same orders.
